passages.text: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled before them, and many fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines fought against Israel.
The Philistines were Israel’s enemies.
The men of Israel ran away from the Philistines.
Many Israelites died on Mount Gilboa.
passages.original: וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים נִלְחֲמ֣וּ בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּ֑נָס אִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיִּפְּל֥וּ חֲלָלִ֖ים בְּהַ֥ר גִּלְבֹּֽעַ׃

passages.text: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and his sons, and they killed Saul’s sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines were enemies of Israel.
The Philistines chased Saul.
The Philistines also chased Saul’s sons.
Saul was the king of Israel.
Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua were sons of Saul.
The Philistines killed Jonathan.
The Philistines killed Abinadab.
The Philistines killed Malchishua.
Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua were all sons of Saul.
passages.original: וַיַּדְבְּק֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל וְאַחֲרֵ֣י בָנָ֑יו וַיַּכּ֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים אֶת־ יוֹנָתָ֧ן וְאֶת־ אֲבִינָדָ֛ב וְאֶת־ מַלְכִּי־ שׁ֖וּעַ בְּנֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל׃

passages.text: When the battle intensified against Saul, the archers overtook him and wounded him.
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
The battle became fierce against Saul.
Archers found Saul.
The archers shot at Saul.
The archers wounded Saul.
passages.original: וַתִּכְבַּ֤ד הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ עַל־ שָׁא֔וּל וַיִּמְצָאֻ֖הוּ הַמּוֹרִ֣ים בַּקָּ֑שֶׁת וַיָּ֖חֶל מִן־ הַיּוֹרִֽים׃

passages.text: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and run it through me, or these uncircumcised men will come and torture me!” But his armor-bearer was terrified and refused to do it. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
The Philistines were Israel’s enemies.
Saul was wounded in battle.
Saul spoke to his armor-bearer.
Saul said, “Draw your sword.
Stab me with it.
If you do not, these uncircumcised men will come.
They will torture me.”
The armor-bearer was very afraid.
He refused to kill Saul.
Saul took his own sword.
Saul fell on his sword.
Saul killed himself.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁאוּל֩ אֶל־ נֹשֵׂ֨א כֵלָ֜יו שְׁלֹ֥ף חַרְבְּךָ֣׀ וְדָקְרֵ֣נִי בָ֗הּ פֶּן־ יָבֹ֜אוּ הָעֲרֵלִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ וְהִתְעַלְּלוּ־ בִ֔י וְלֹ֤א אָבָה֙ נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֔יו כִּ֥י יָרֵ֖א מְאֹ֑דס וַיִּקַּ֤ח שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת־ הַחֶ֔רֶב וַיִּפֹּ֖ל עָלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his own sword and died.
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
Saul fought in a hard battle.
Saul was wounded by archers.
Saul asked his armor-bearer to kill him.
The armor-bearer was very afraid.
The armor-bearer refused to kill Saul.
Saul fell on his own sword and died.
The armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead.
The armor-bearer fell on his own sword.
The armor-bearer died.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥רְא נֹשֵֽׂא־ כֵלָ֖יו כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּפֹּ֥ל גַּם־ ה֛וּא עַל־ הַחֶ֖רֶב וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

passages.text: So Saul died together with his three sons and all his house.
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
Saul died.
Saul’s three sons died.
All the men of Saul’s house died with him.
passages.original: וַיָּ֤מָת שָׁאוּל֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת בָּנָ֔יו וְכָל־ בֵּית֖וֹ יַחְדָּ֥ו מֵֽתוּ׃

passages.text: When all the Israelites in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their cities and ran away. So the Philistines came and occupied their cities.
passages.sermon:
All the Israelites in the valley saw what happened.
They saw that the army had fled.
They saw that Saul had died.
They saw that Saul’s sons had died.
The Israelites abandoned their cities.
They ran away.
The Philistines came to those cities.
The Philistines lived in those cities.
passages.original: וַ֠יִּרְאוּ כָּל־ אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ בָּעֵ֙מֶק֙ כִּ֣י נָ֔סוּ וְכִי־ מֵ֖תוּ שָׁא֣וּל וּבָנָ֑יו וַיַּעַזְב֤וּ עָרֵיהֶם֙ וַיָּנֻ֔סוּ וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ בָּהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines were Israel’s enemies.
The day after the battle, the Philistines came to the battlefield.
They came to strip the dead bodies.
They found Saul on Mount Gilboa.
They found Saul’s sons with him.
Saul and his sons had fallen in battle on Mount Gilboa.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים לְפַשֵּׁ֖ט אֶת־ הַֽחֲלָלִ֑ים וַֽיִּמְצְא֤וּ אֶת־ שָׁאוּל֙ וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֔יו נֹפְלִ֖ים בְּהַ֥ר גִּלְבֹּֽעַ׃

passages.text: They stripped Saul, cut off his head, took his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news in the temple of their idols and among their people.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines found Saul dead on Mount Gilboa.
They stripped Saul’s body.
They cut off Saul’s head.
They took Saul’s armor.
They sent messengers through the land of the Philistines.
They told the news to their idols’ temples.
They told the news to their people.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨פְשִׁיטֻ֔הוּ וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְאֶת־ כֵּלָ֑יו וַיְשַׁלְּח֨וּ בְאֶֽרֶץ־ פְלִשְׁתִּ֜ים סָבִ֗יב לְבַשֵּׂ֛ר אֶת־ עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־ הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: They put his armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of Dagon.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines took Saul’s armor.
They placed his armor in the temple of their gods.
They took Saul’s head.
They hung his head in the temple of Dagon.
passages.original: וַיָּשִׂ֙ימוּ֙ אֶת־ כֵּלָ֔יו בֵּ֖ית אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וְאֶת־ גֻּלְגָּלְתּ֥וֹ תָקְע֖וּ בֵּ֥ית דָּגֽוֹן׃ס

passages.text: When the people of Jabesh-gilead heard about everything the Philistines had done to Saul, all their men of valor set out and retrieved the bodies of Saul and his sons and brought them to Jabesh. And they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh and fasted seven days.
passages.sermon:
The people of Jabesh-gilead heard what the Philistines did to Saul.
Jabesh-gilead was a city in Israel.
The Philistines had killed Saul.
The Philistines had also killed Saul’s sons.
The Philistines had mistreated their bodies.
All the brave men of Jabesh-gilead got up.
They went to where Saul and his sons’ bodies were.
They took the bodies of Saul and his sons.
They brought the bodies back to Jabesh.
They buried the bones of Saul and his sons under the oak tree in Jabesh.
The people of Jabesh-gilead fasted for seven days.
passages.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֔וּ כֹּ֖ל יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֥וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לְשָׁאֽוּל׃ וַיָּקוּמוּ֮ כָּל־ אִ֣ישׁ חַיִל֒ וַיִּשְׂא֞וּ אֶת־ גּוּפַ֣ת שָׁא֗וּל וְאֵת֙ גּוּפֹ֣ת בָּנָ֔יו וַיְבִיא֖וּם יָבֵ֑ישָׁה וַיִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֶת־ עַצְמוֹתֵיהֶ֜ם תַּ֤חַת הָאֵלָה֙ בְּיָבֵ֔שׁ וַיָּצ֖וּמוּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃

passages.text: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness to the LORD, because he did not keep the word of the LORD and even consulted a medium for guidance, and he failed to inquire of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
passages.sermon:
Saul was king of Israel.
Saul acted unfaithfully toward the LORD.
He did not obey the word of the LORD.
He also asked a medium for guidance.
He did not seek the LORD.
The LORD put Saul to death.
The LORD gave the kingdom to David, son of Jesse.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣מָת שָׁא֗וּל בְּמַֽעֲלוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעַ֣ל בַּֽיהוָ֔ה עַל־ דְּבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ שָׁמָ֑ר וְגַם־ לִשְׁא֥וֹל בָּא֖וֹב לִדְרֽוֹשׁ׃ וְלֹֽא־ דָרַ֥שׁ בַּֽיהוָ֖ה וַיְמִיתֵ֑הוּ וַיַּסֵּב֙ אֶת־ הַמְּלוּכָ֔ה לְדָוִ֖יד בֶּן־ יִשָֽׁי׃פ
